title: Sale Ad Creatives With Editable Offers | AIVideosUGC
description: Build a sale ad creative from one product photo. Add the confirmed price, code and end date after download, then reuse the scene when the promotion changes.
h1: Make Sale Ad Creatives From One Product Photo
lead: Start your sale ad before the offer is final. Build the product scene now, then add the confirmed price, code and date after download. Need a short sale video ad? [Build one from a product photo](/ai-video-generation/ugc-ad-video).

faq.q: Can AIVideosUGC put the discount on the image for me?
faq.a: No. Keep the percentage, price, code and end date as editable text in Canva, CapCut or Ads Manager so you can proofread every character.

faq.q: Can I reuse a sale visual for my next promotion?
faq.a: Yes. The product scene stays separate from the offer layer. Replace the text when the promotion changes and keep the same visual.

faq.q: Can I show the original price next to the sale price?
faq.a: Only show an original price you actually charged. Review the comparison-pricing rules that apply where you sell before publishing the claim.

faq.q: How much open space should I leave for the offer?
faq.a: Leave clear space for the offer line and code without covering the product. Preview the smallest screen to make sure both remain readable.

faq.q: Do I need a creator for sale videos?
faq.a: No. Start with your product photo and a chosen scene. The generated file gives you the visual, and you add the offer afterward.

faq.q: Can I run the finished visual as a paid sale ad?
faq.a: Yes. Downloaded files carry no AIVideosUGC watermark and are yours to use in paid promotions, subject to the platform rules for your ad.
